test_exception_documentation: run the test to verify all litellm exception types are documented in the exception mapping markdown file
review_exception_coverage: review whether all litellm public exception types have corresponding entries in the documentation
extract_error_names: extract error type names from litellm LITELLM_EXCEPTION_TYPES using a regex pattern
parse_documented_exceptions: parse the exception mapping markdown file to extract documented exception types from the table
compare_exceptions: compare litellm exception types against documented ones and raise an error for any undocumented keys
